name: Godou Daisuke
source:
Son of the current head of the Godou family, he is next-in-line as the leader of the Yakuza.  Foul-mouthed and hotheaded, he is kept in check by his right-hand man, Shiga.

Weapon of choice: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beretta_93R]Beretta M93R[/url] (9mm Machine Pistol).
